title: Project Closeout Approval Form
use_case: Use the approval form during construction project turnover and closeout when the project closeout record must identify contract deliverables, systems, spaces, warranties, training, keys, spare parts, and financial records. Complete the applicable handoff for owner receipt, final completion determination, warranty start, archive index, financial reconciliation, and responsibility handoff.
